title: The Quiet Change — 20s Invisalign spot, Murfree Dental

format.note: Vertical 9:16 for Reels/TikTok. For landscape use 1280x704.

voiceover.script: Some changes announce themselves. Yours doesn't have to. Invisalign clear aligners — designed by Dr. Murfree with three-D precision, and worn through real life: meetings, dinners, everything between. Until one day you catch your reflection... and there it is. Murfree Dental, Murfreesboro. murfree dental dot com.
voiceover.timing: 0-3s hook / 3-12s body over shots 2-3 / 12-17s reveal / 17-20s brand over endcard
voiceover.note: Record with a warm-voiced team member, or ~1 Higgsfield credit for a Maya take. Music: minimal warm piano + light strings, ducked under VO.

negative_prompt: garish colors, overexposed, static image, blurry details, subtitles, on-screen text, watermark, logo, painting, illustration, gray flat tone, worst quality, deformed hands, extra fingers, distorted teeth, extra teeth, uncanny face, lip-sync
character_note: All four shots describe the same woman for continuity. Identity drift across separate generations is a known limitation — if drift is visible, either re-roll seeds, or switch to the 'four patients' variant by changing the subject description per shot (the ad reads equally well as four different patients).

shots.beat: Product mechanic — aligner in, day begins
shots.prompt: Cinematic commercial, photoreal film quality. Soft dawn light in a modern bathroom, gentle window glow, soft teal and warm coral accents. A woman in her late twenties with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a soft teal top, leans toward the mirror and gently seats a clear dental aligner onto her upper teeth with one practiced motion, then studies her reflection with a growing half-smile. Shallow depth of field, warm natural skin tones, realistic natural teeth. Camera: slow push-in over her shoulder toward the mirror reflection.

Cinematic commercial, photoreal film quality. Bright glass-walled meeting room in late-morning sun, soft teal and warm coral accents in the decor. A woman in her late twenties with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a soft teal blouse, stands presenting to colleagues and laughs naturally mid-gesture, completely at ease, natural realistic smile. Colleagues in soft focus. Camera: slow lateral dolly gliding past the glass wall into the room.

Cinematic commercial, photoreal film quality. Golden-hour dinner on a warm restaurant patio, string-light bokeh, teal napkins and coral flowers on the table. A woman in her late twenties with shoulder-length dark hair laughs with two friends and reaches for a shared dish; beside her plate a small closed clear aligner case catches the warm light. Camera: slow arc around the table ending on her relaxed genuine smile.

shots.beat: Reveal — the quiet change, then endcard
shots.prompt: Cinematic commercial, photoreal film quality. Dusk on a charming small-town main street with warm shop-window light and soft lens flare. A woman in her late twenties with shoulder-length dark hair pauses at a shop window, catches her own reflection, and breaks into a genuine confident smile, realistic natural teeth. Camera: slow push-in from behind her shoulder to her reflected smile.
